description: NTU COOL (Canvas LMS) read-only query server — courses, assignments, submissions, announcements, files
long_description: Read-only MCP server for NTU COOL, National Taiwan University's Canvas LMS deployment. Confirmed via live verification (PsychQuant/ntu-claude-plugins#17) that NTU COOL is a customized Canvas deployment with a fully open standard Canvas REST API. Provides tools to list courses, assignments, announcements, submission/grading status, files, and course enrollments. Requires a Canvas Personal Access Token stored in the macOS keychain (service `ntu-cool-canvas`) — the token is never read from an environment variable or written to disk. v0.1.0 is deliberately read-only: grade posting and announcement creation are teaching-incident-risk operations left for a later, more deliberate version.
name: che-ntucool-mcp

tools.description: List courses the token owner is enrolled in or teaching
tools.name: list_courses

tools.name: list_announcements

tools.description: List submission/grading status for every student in a course

tools.description: List the enrollment roster for a course
tools.name: list_enrollments
